claim_boundary: A sensitivity sweep evidences robustness to one governed assumption. It is not a calibration and does not license a measured-share claim.
design: Paired comparison under common random numbers: the Beta draw seed excludes the anchor weight, so the arms share draws and differences are attributable to the weight rather than to Monte Carlo noise.
headline: The top-8 selection is NOT invariant across 0.20-0.50; see comparisons.
known_truth_boundary: Coverage and CRPS are evaluated only in a seeded synthetic known-truth laboratory. They do not demonstrate real-client calibration.
